S03c Adoption at session start (in `initSession`, after the own ring is loaded and `readPrior` ran; once per session start, not on `/clear`): compute the settled ids = every row id whose state is 'sent' or 'dead' in any file read or in this process's rings. S03d The adopted copy keeps the original id (never recompute it), ts, kind, session_id (the original writer's), cwd_rel, goal, files_touched, decisions, todos_completed, note, intended_event and attempts; state is 'pending'; it gains `adopted_from: <source file key>`. S03f `foldedDead` (prior dead rows shown as `⚠ N undeliverable`) counts an earlier-session dead row only if its id is not 'sent' in any file read or in this process's rings.
